about_the_game:
A 3D exploration horror action game where you recall the sins you committed in this life and try to escape from a labyrinth

【Story】

When you wake up, you find yourself in an unfamiliar landscape.

Apparently this is eternal life.

You committed a certain "sin" in this world and died, and now you are imprisoned in a huge labyrinth called "Mumei" in this eternal world.

But you don't remember what sins you have committed.

Furthermore, he cannot remember not only his crime, but also his own name.

To escape, you must rely on the "Documents" to collect "Mystery Items" and remember the sins you committed in this life.

So, will you be able to escape from here?

【How to play the game】

　●Explore the stage in first-person view and obtain one document item.

　●You can check the details of the documents you have obtained by selecting "Check Item" on the pause screen.

　●Use the contents of the document as a clue to explore and obtain mystery items (up to 5).

　●The game is cleared when you touch the goal object and select a mystery item related to the contents of the document.

　●If you are attacked by a "Wanderer" while exploring, the game will end.

【Strategy points】

●Random stage：

The stage changes every time you play the game, so adapt and try to escape!

●You need at least two items to escape!?：

It's possible to clear the stage with only one mystery item!

It's a good idea to use the documents to collect the mystery items you think you'll need.

【How to operate】

■Keyboard and mouse operation…

　●W,A,S,D　or　↑,←,↓,→…Move

　●Left Shift, Right Shift…Dash

　●Move mouse…Move viewpoint

　●Left click…Interact

　●Right click…Use Item

　●F or 1 …Light flashing

　●P or Z …Pause/Unpause

　●Space…Advance the conversation

　●Left Ctrl, Right Ctrl…Look back
